prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Interactive flow additions consistently won (up to +14.8%) and frequently outperformed predictions.
Reordering flow steps produced large wins (up to +12.0%), but carries severe downside risk (down to -8.9%) and frequently showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates yielded wins for persistence notices (+3.5%) and launch buttons (+6.7%), though other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting screen features produced a win (+3.9%), but mostly showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns failed to win, performed worse than predicted, and frequently caused severe performance drops (down to -19.3%).
Hints, notifications, layout changes, and standalone preview screens yielded no wins, with hints sometimes hurting performance (-3.1%) and others showing no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Trait Customizer Flow: Adds an interactive trait selector screen right before certificate generation where users pick pet temperament traits (Playful, Calm, Energetic). (why: Interactive flow additions consistently won (+14.8%). The adoption stage experiences a sharp drop-off (71.2%), making interactive customization an effective engagement driver.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pet Pick Stage: Moves sign-in screen immediately after selecting a companion in pick_friend, ensuring account creation locks in pet selection early. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after re-signing in. Prompting sign-in right after pet selection prevents data loss and aligns with step reordering wins.)
2: [home, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Toy Box Screen: Inserts an interactive toy box activity screen into the waiting stage where users test desktop toys while generation finishes. (why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s. Interactive additions during waiting provide immediate engagement during processing times.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Loss Prevention Sign-In Notice: Updates headline and body copy on sign_in screen to stress cloud pet backup and prevent account overwrite confusion. (why: Targeted copy updates for account persistence yielded +3.5% wins and directly address the top support issue (8 emails about missing/reset pets).)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Launch Button Clarity Update: Changes primary action button on home_intro to explicitly instruct launching and placing pet on active screen. (why: Launch button copy improvements previously boosted completion by +6.7%, and support received reports of pets not showing up on desktop.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Reward: Adds a founder adoption badge asset to the adoption certificate screen celebrating official pet ownership. (why: The adoption stage drops 28.8% of users (71.2% completion). Adding positive reinforcement boosts motivation to finish adoption.)
6: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Pet Starter Care Quiz Flow: Inserts a 2-question interactive quiz right after path selection to tailor desktop pet energy and schedule preferences. (why: Interactive flows generate strong conversion gains (+14.8%) and lower initial friction on choose_path (78.3% step completion).)
7: [sign_in, notification] Existing Account Pet Sync Notification: Adds a sync notice badge on sign_in screen confirming existing accounts restore existing pets automatically. (why: Directly targets the #1 support issue (8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again).)
